grades.quote: The interaction of the memory model with I/O memory, instruction fetches, FENCE.I, page table walks, and SFENCE.VMA is not (yet) formalized.
grades.reason: It only notes that the memory model's interaction with instruction fetches and FENCE.I is not formalized. It never says whether a local FENCE.I synchronizes other harts' instruction fetch, so it gives limited background.
It covers the aq/rl ordering bits on atomic instructions and says nothing about FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
It describes the data-memory FENCE instruction and its PR/PW/SR/SW bits. It does not cover FENCE.I or instruction fetch synchronization across harts.
It lists the operational model's per-hart state components and has no bearing on FENCE.I or cross-hart instruction fetch synchronization.
